description: A deck check question (porch-12x10, Deck 1 selected): the end and middle post lines, cited.
question: how tall are the deck posts, and how much does the middle one carry?
reply: The end posts are 4x4s reaching 1'-6 1/2" from grade to the beam's underside [[ref:End posts 4x4]], and the middle post carries 29.6 square feet [[ref:Middle post 4x4]].
